upgrades.title: TeePee Ranch House
upgrades.description: This simple structure provides great flexibility, but does not allow for much expansion of your ranch.

upgrades.title: Ranch Shack
upgrades.description: This small shack is just big enough to live in.  It provides for 2 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Small Ranch Cabin
upgrades.description: This small cabin is much more comfortable than a shack, and it provides for 4 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Large Ranch Cabin
upgrades.description: The additional space of the large cabin makes for a very comfortable lifestyle.  It also provides for 6 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Small Ranch House
upgrades.description: This small house makes life very comfortable.  It also provides for 8 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Medium Ranch House
upgrades.description: This ranch house provides up to 10 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Large Ranch House
upgrades.description: This large ranch house provides for 12 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Huge Ranch Estate
upgrades.description: This huge home supports up to 14 out buildings.

upgrades.title: Enormous Ranch Estate
upgrades.description: This huge home supports up to 16 out buildings.

buildings.title: Horse Stable Barn
buildings.description: This nice barn is big enough to allow you to own 4 more horses

buildings.title: Water Well
buildings.description: Having a well automatically waters all of your horses and yourself whenever you are here

buildings.title: Grain Silo
buildings.description: Building a grain silo automatically feeds your horses

buildings.title: Shed
buildings.description: A shed is a great place to store excess stuff.   You can carry up to 20 more items in your inventory. (Max 2 sheds.)

buildings.title: Flower Garden
buildings.description: A simple, pretty flower garden.  It's just nice to look at

buildings.title: Training Pen
buildings.description: The training pen allows for free horse training once per game day. (Max 1 training pen.)

buildings.title: Wagon
buildings.description: Building a wagon provides you free transport to the nearest wagon station and free use of wagons

buildings.title: Windmill
buildings.description: A windmill automatically makes you $10,000 of money every game day

buildings.title: Vegetable Garden
buildings.description: The garden automatically feeds the owner whenever they visit

buildings.title: Horse Stable Big Barn
buildings.description: This larger barn is big enough to allow you to own 8 more horses

buildings.title: Horse Stable Gold Barn
buildings.description: This large, fancy barn is big enough to allow you to own 12 more horses
